MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 41

4. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 13
   C. 9
   D. 12

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

6. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

12. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME

1. C — 10

2. B — 27 cm³

3. D — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

4. D — 12
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 21 − 9
3. x = 12
Final Answer: x = 12
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
